item.title: Russia accuses Ukraine of violating U.S.-brokered three-day truce
item.description: Russia accused Kyiv of breaking a U.S.-brokered ceasefire on Sunday, while Ukrainian officials said that one person had been killed and more injured by Russian drone and artillery strikes in the past 24 hours

item.title: Iran wants team members who served in the Revolutionary Guard to get visas for the World Cup
item.description: Iran's soccer federation says the country will participate in the 2026 FIFA World Cup

item.title: Rwanda-backed rebels accuse the US of falling short as a peace mediator in Congo's conflict
item.description: Rebels in Congo say the United States has fallen short as a mediator in efforts to end the conflict in the African country’s mineral-rich east

item.title: Ukrainians seeking cultural escape from war’s brutality find comfort and resilience at Kyiv art fair
item.description: A contemporary art fair has opened in Kyiv under the theme that art can help society cope with the realities of war

item.title: Britain's Starmer fights for his job as calls for his ouster grow
item.description: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer is fighting for his job after poor local election results for his Labour Party
